description: This Java source file defines the BackgroundPickers class, which manages UI components for selecting background images in an Android wearable notification support application.

classes.name: BackgroundPickers
classes.description: Manages a collection of background image pickers within a specified container view. Supports generating, retrieving, and clearing pickers, as well as handling user interactions for background selection.

methods.name: BackgroundPickers
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BackgroundPickers with a container view and a listener for changes.

methods.name: generatePickers
methods.description: Dynamically creates a specified number of background picker UI elements within the container.

methods.name: getRes
methods.description: Returns the resource ID of the background image at a given index.

methods.name: getRes
methods.description: Returns an array of resource IDs for all managed pickers.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all picker views from the container and clears internal state.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of pickers currently managed.
